description: This file defines the OX_Admin_UI_Wizard class, which manages a multi-step wizard interface, including step navigation, data storage, and metadata handling within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Wizard
classes.description: Class for managing multi-step wizard workflows, including step navigation, data persistence, and metadata management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wizard with an ID, options, and storage backend.

methods.name: setSteps
methods.description: Sets the sequence of steps for the wizard.

methods.name: getSteps
methods.description: Returns the array of step names.

methods.name: setCurrentStep
methods.description: Sets the current active step.

methods.name: getCurrentStep
methods.description: Retrieves the current active step.

methods.name: getFirstStep
methods.description: Returns the first step ID.

methods.name: getLastStep
methods.description: Returns the last step ID.

methods.name: getNextStep
methods.description: Returns the next step ID after a given step.

methods.name: getPreviousStep
methods.description: Returns the previous step ID before a given step.

methods.name: getStepData
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a specific step.

methods.name: setStepData
methods.description: Stores data for a specific step.

methods.name: getStepMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific step.

methods.name: setStepMeta
methods.description: Sets metadata for a specific step.

methods.name: markStepAsCompleted
methods.description: Marks a step as completed.

methods.name: isStepCompleted
methods.description: Checks if a step has been marked as completed.

methods.name: getLastCompletedStep
methods.description: Returns the last step marked as completed.

methods.name: isStep
methods.description: Checks if a step ID exists in the sequence.

methods.name: checkStepReachable
methods.description: Determines if a step is reachable based on completion of previous steps.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the wizard to its initial state, clearing all data and progress.

methods.name: getWizardData
methods.description: Retrieves the wizard's stored data from the storage backend.

methods.name: setWizardData
methods.description: Stores the wizard's data into the storage backend.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Returns the storage object used for data persistence.
